summary: The proof is mathematically complete. The one-sided augmentation preserves the full barycentric representation polytope and hence the complete core, the relative-to-ambient halfspace argument gives the required balance, the capacity supremum passage is valid, and the hard-branch minimum argument correctly implies the ambient-normalized lower-rank and one-factor packet bounds. Boundary cases, zero added mass, zero packet energy, full rank, proper rank, and nonsaturated embeddings are all covered.
